Hydor is not a service you sign up for. It is an app that runs where you choose, with the AI you choose.
On your Mac or PC, a Linux box at home o: On your Mac or PC, a Linux box at home or a server you rent. Your sessions, files and memory stay there.
The Claude and ChatGPT plans you have, A: The Claude and ChatGPT plans you have, API keys, OpenRouter, or free models on your own computer.
Passwords and keys live in an encrypted: Passwords and keys live in an encrypted vault. Agents use them by name, only on the sites you allow.
Open source under the GNU AGPL 3.0: read: Open source under the GNU AGPL 3.0: read every line and change what you like; whoever shares a changed version, or runs one for others, shares their changes too. In English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Greek, Japanese or Chinese.
Yes. Hydor is free and open source, unde: Yes. Hydor is free and open source, under the GNU AGPL 3.0: use it for anything and build on it; if you share a changed version or run one for others, you share your changes too. The AI it uses is your own: a Claude or ChatGPT plan you already pay for, API keys, models you pay for as you go through OpenRouter, or free models that run on your own computer.

Where do my conversations and files live: Where do my conversations and files live?
On the computer that runs Hydor. Your se: On the computer that runs Hydor. Your sessions, files, memory and keys are kept there, not in a Hydor cloud. Agents reach the AI services and websites you choose from there.
Does Hydor collect data about me?: Does Hydor collect data about me?
No. Hydor has no telemetry, analytics or: No. Hydor has no telemetry, analytics or crash reports, no account with us and no install ID. Your conversations go only to the model you chose. The few other connections it makes (update checks, price and model lists, one-time downloads, and the searches your agents ask for) are listed host by host, with how to turn each off, in <0>What leaves your computer</0>.

What does Hydor do that ChatGPT and Clau: What does Hydor do that ChatGPT and Claude don’t?
It runs on your own computer, with your: It runs on your own computer, with your Claude and ChatGPT plans and any model in one app, and one memory that you can read and edit. It also makes apps from a description, pins answers to boards, checks goals itself, suggests words as you type from a model on your computer, and queues experiments for a free GPU. The apps do some of these in part, or not at all. They do things Hydor doesn’t, too. <0>The comparison</0> has each one, with sources.
